title: An Investigational Drug Study in Obese (Considerably Overweight) Patients (0364-006)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and effectiveness of an investigational drug in patients with obesity (considerably overweight).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are obese (considerably overweight) based on body mass index.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with serious or unstable current or past medical conditions
